headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $81,000 Following Asian Tech Rally
summary: Bitcoin rose above $81,400 as Asian chip stocks rallied, while alternative tokens such as pepe also posted gains.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital asset by market capitalization, often tracking broader risk-asset sentiment and liquidity trends.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Positive sentiment in broader risk markets spills over into digital asset demand.

why_moved: Spillover momentum from surging regional equity markets boosts risk appetite across cryptocurrency trading desks.
